instruction: Sign a zone with DNSSEC using dnssec-signzone
output: dnssec-signzone -o example.com db.example.com

instruction: Sign a zone with NSEC3 and a custom salt
output: dnssec-signzone -o example.com -S db.example.com

instruction: Generate a DNSSEC key pair (zone signing key)
output:
Generating ZSK key pair (256 bits)...
Kexample.com.+008+12345

Created key: /etc/bind/Kexample.com.+008+12345.key
Created private: /etc/bind/Kexample.com.+008+12345.private

Key tag: 12345
Algorithm: RSASHA256 (8)
Size: 256 bits
Use dnssec-keygen -f KSK for a Key Signing Key.

instruction: Generate a KSK (Key Signing Key) for DNSSEC
output:
Generating KSK key pair (2048 bits)...
Kexample.com.+008+67890

Created key: /etc/bind/Kexample.com.+008+67890.key
Created private: /etc/bind/Kexample.com.+008+67890.private

Key tag: 67890
Algorithm: RSASHA256 (8)
Size: 2048 bits
KSK should have a higher bit length for security.

instruction: Generate a DNSSEC key with ECDSAP256SHA256 algorithm
output:
Generating ZSK key pair (256 bits)...
Kexample.com.+013+11111

Created key: /etc/bind/Kexample.com.+013+11111.key
Created private: /etc/bind/Kexample.com.+013+11111.private

Key tag: 11111
Algorithm: ECDSAP256SHA256 (13)
Size: 256 bits

EC algorithm keys are smaller and faster than RSA.

instruction: Set the activation time on a DNSSEC key
output:
Key Kexample.com.+008+12345:
  Active: now (2024-07-25 11:40:00)
  Inactive: (unset)
  Delete: (unset)
  Published: now (2024-07-25 11:40:00)
  Revoke: (unset)

Use dnssec-settime -P now -A now +180d to schedule future activation.

instruction: Set key timing for DNSSEC rollover
output:
Key Kexample.com.+008+12345:
  Active: 2024-08-25 00:00:00
  Inactive: 2024-10-25 00:00:00
  Delete: 2024-11-25 00:00:00
  Published: 2024-08-01 00:00:00
  Revoke: (unset)

Scheduled ZSK rollover. Publish before active to allow cache expiration.

instruction: Revoke a DNSSEC key
output:
Key Kexample.com.+008+67890:
  Published: now
  Active: now
  Revoked: now

SETREVOKE flag set. The key will be published with the REVOKE bit set.
Use dnssec-settime -R now to set the revocation time.

instruction: Set a DS publication date for a DNSSEC key
output:
Key Kexample.com.+008+67890:
  Published: now
  Active: 2024-08-25 00:00:00
  DS: 2024-08-01 00:00:00 (parent publishes DS record)

The DS publish time should precede the key activation time.

instruction: View DNSSEC key details
output:
Key: Kexample.com.+008+12345
Algorithm: RSASHA256 (8)
Key Size: 256 bits

Timing:

  Inactive: (not set)

instruction: Generate a key pair with specific publication date
output:
Generating ZSK key pair (256 bits)...
Kexample.com.+008+22222

Key created with:
  Published: 2024-07-01 00:00:00
  Active: 2024-07-15 00:00:00

Use -P and -A to set publication and activation timestamps.

instruction: Check DNSSEC key timings
output:
Key: Kexample.com.+008+12345
  Publish: 2024-07-25 11:40:00
  Activate: 2024-07-25 11:40:00
  Inactive: 2025-07-25 11:40:00
  Delete: 2025-08-01 11:40:00
  Revoke: (unset)

Next rollover: ZSK scheduled at 2025-07-25

instruction: Resign a zone with updated keys
output:
Re-signing zone with existing keys:
- ZSK: Kexample.com.+008+12345
- KSK: Kexample.com.+008+67890

Signatures refreshed for all RRsets.
RRSIG validity: 30 days

Signed zone file updated.

instruction: Verify DNSSEC signatures in a zone file
output: dnssec-signzone -o example.com -N INCREMENT db.example.com

instruction: Sign a zone with a specific key directory
output:
Using keys from /etc/bind/keys/

Zone signing complete:
Algorithm: NSEC3RSASHA256
Signatures generated: 15
Signatures verified: 15
Signing time: 0.18 seconds
Signed zone file: /etc/bind/db.example.com.signed

instruction: Print the DNSSEC key tag for management
output:
Kexample.com.+008+12345.key: tag = 12345
Kexample.com.+008+67890.key: tag = 67890

Use the key tag to reference keys in dnssec-settime and dnssec-revoke.

instruction: Re-sign a zone without changing keys
output:
Maintaining existing keys:
- ZSK: 12345 (Kexample.com.+008+12345)
- KSK: 67890 (Kexample.com.+008+67890)

Signatures refreshed: 12
Validity period extended for another 30 days.

instruction: Generate an ECDSA key for DNSSEC
output:
Generating ZSK key pair (384 bits)...
Kexample.com.+014+33333

Algorithm: ECDSAP384SHA384 (14)
Key Tag: 33333

ECDSAP384SHA384 is FIPS-compliant and provides strong security.

instruction: Set the inactive time on a ZSK before rollover
output:
Key Kexample.com.+008+12345 inactive time set to 2024-09-25 00:00:00.

Existing ZSK becomes inactive after the new ZSK is active.

instruction: Check the DNSSEC key state before a rollover
output:
Key: Kexample.com.+008+12345 (ZSK)
  Published: 2024-07-25 11:40:00
  Active: 2024-07-25 11:40:00
  Retired: (not set)
  Removed: (not set)

Use dnssec-settime -I <date> to schedule key retirement.
